title: Suggestions (Console) UI implementation notes / scratchpad
content:
Context
- This is an eng scratchpad for the Suggestions view (beta) in Redwood Console.
- Scope: list view + detail drawer, read-only behind feature flags/allowlist.
- Primary integration path: Console -> BFF (console backend) -> suggestions-service.
- Related work: analytics events (impression/open/filter), RBAC/audit logging, schema versioning for savings/risk payloads.

Owners / dependencies
- UI implementation: Nora Ahmed / Felix Schneider
- BFF integration + gating: Chloe Martin / Jada Williams (see redwood/pr-18674)
- Design system components: Svetlana Orlov
- Design review / copy: Tessa Morgan, Kenji Nakamura, Alicia Perez
- QA automation: Leila Farouk
- Telemetry/analytics events: Logan Wright (event naming/fields; see ENG-2409)

Entry points / routing
- Nav placement per DES-189: Console left nav -> Optimize -> Suggestions (Beta).
- Route (proposed): /console/:workspaceId/optimize/suggestions
  - keeps parity with other Optimize surfaces
  - allows deep-linking w/ query params for filtering
- Detail drawer is not a route (no full page); but we should support shareable link:
  - /console/:workspaceId/optimize/suggestions?suggestionId=sg_123
  - on load: open drawer automatically if suggestionId present (and user has access)

Feature gating / access
- Client gating: suggestions_beta feature flag + allowlist at workspace/account
  - if not enabled: hide nav item entirely (vs show and 404). Confirm with PM (Marissa).
- Server enforcement (must-have): BFF checks allowlist + RBAC permission before calling suggestions-service
  - UI still should handle 403 with a helpful error state
- RBAC permission string (placeholder): optimize:suggestions:read
  - verify with ENG-2408; ensure consistent with audit logs

Data fetching: endpoints + query model
- Use BFF endpoints (preferred) to avoid leaking internal service URLs + keep auth consistent.
- BFF list endpoint (shape from PR-18674 / contract draft):
  - GET /api/console/optimize/suggestions?route_id=&model_id=&region=&risk_level=&status=&cursor=&limit=
  - Returns list + next_cursor (or null)
- BFF detail endpoint:
  - GET /api/console/optimize/suggestions/:id
  - Returns a fully hydrated suggestion including rationale, savings model, basis-of-estimate.

React query states (list)
- Loading (initial): show page skeleton (table header + 5–8 skeleton rows)
- Loading (refetch due to filter changes): keep previous data (stale-while-revalidate) but show subtle spinner in header + disable pagination clicks
- Error:
  - if 403: "Suggestions beta isn’t enabled for this workspace" (action: link to docs / contact CSM)
  - if 5xx: generic "Couldn’t load suggestions" + retry
  - if 504/timeout: "Loading is taking longer than expected" + retry
- Empty:
  - if enabled + request succeeds + items=0: show empty state per DES-189
  - NOTE: empty state copy should differentiate between:
    - "No suggestions found" (filters too narrow)
    - "No suggestions available yet" (we have traffic but signals not meeting thresholds)
    - "Insufficient telemetry" (we don’t have baselines; surfaced if backend sends reason_code)

React query states (detail drawer)
- Drawer open triggers detail fetch (unless list already contains full payload; currently list contains summary only).
- While fetching: drawer skeleton (title line, 2–3 sections skeleton)
- Error in drawer:
  - show inline error panel; keep list usable; provide "Close" + "Retry"

Component breakdown (current)
Page layout
- <SuggestionsPage>
  - page header: title + subtitle + docs link
  - feature flag notice (small "Beta" pill)
  - <SuggestionsFiltersBar>
  - <SuggestionsTable>
  - <PaginationControls>
  - <SuggestionDetailDrawer>

Filters
- <SuggestionsFiltersBar>
  - Route selector (typeahead)
  - Model selector (typeahead)
  - Region dropdown (single)
  - Risk dropdown (multi? design currently single; see open question)
  - Sort control: default = "Highest estimated monthly savings" (confirm)
  - Clear filters

Table
- <SuggestionsTable>
  - columns (from DES-188):
    - Suggestion (title + short "what to change")
    - Applies to (route/model/region chips)
    - Est. savings (e.g. $/1M tokens + monthly estimate)
    - Risk (chip: Low/Medium/High)
    - Status (for beta: always "Available"; future: Adopted/Dismissed)
  - row click opens drawer
  - row actions: none (read-only beta)

Drawer sections
- <SuggestionDetailDrawer>
  - Header: suggestion title + applies-to summary
  - Savings section
    - <SavingsSummary>
    - <SavingsBreakdownTable> (baseline vs projected, $/1M tokens, monthly impact)
    - <SavingsConfidenceBlock> (show confidence range + "basis" link)
  - Risk section
    - <RiskChip>
    - <RiskRationaleBullets>
    - <AssumptionsList>
    - <ReversibilityCallout> (how to roll back / what changes are being recommended)
  - Basis of estimate (telemetry)
    - <BasisOfEstimate>
      - inputs: baseline window, sample size, token counts, cache hit rate estimates, latency headroom inputs (as allowed)
      - must keep privacy-safe; do not include raw prompts/tenant identifiers beyond route/model/region
  - Footer: "Feedback" link (opens Intercom? or mailto?) + docs link

Design review TODOs (from latest sync w/ Tessa / Kenji)
- Risk chip placement: keep in table (for scanning) AND repeat in drawer header.
- Copy: avoid "You will save"; use "Estimated" + "Based on last N days".
- Drawer hierarchy: Savings first, then Risk, then Telemetry/Basis (current matches).
- Empty states:
  - For "insufficient data" case, show explanation and link to telemetry requirements doc.
  - Avoid showing a blank page; always show at least the empty-state card.
- Accessibility:
  - Ensure drawer focus trap works; ESC closes drawer.
  - Table row selection should be keyboard navigable.
  - Risk chips need accessible labels ("Risk level: High").
- Terminology:
  - Use "Batching" not "Continuous batching" in user-facing UI (can mention in docs).
  - "Caching" should be "Prefix caching" only if we’re sure that’s the mechanism; otherwise keep generic.

Filtering + pagination decisions
- Cursor-based pagination (from PR-18714) is the default for large tenants.
- UI decision: use "Load more" vs numbered pages
  - Current implementation: "Load more" button below table (simpler w/ cursor).
  - Keep filters sticky; when filters change, reset cursor and scroll to top.
- Query params
  - Persist filters to URL so CS/SE can share links:
    - routeId, modelId, region, risk, sort
  - Do NOT persist cursor to URL (avoid weird back-button + page refresh issues).

Sorting
- Default sort: highest estimated monthly savings (descending)
- Alternate sorts (future): highest $/1M tokens delta, lowest risk first
- Note: backend may not support all sorts initially; we should gate UI options based on capabilities field if present.

Schema/versioning considerations (UI)
- Savings estimate payload is versioned (adr-0275).
- UI should not assume fields always exist; must handle:
  - missing confidence_interval
  - missing basis fields (telemetry gap)
  - new savings components (e.g., quantization) without breaking rendering
- Implementation idea:
  - A <SavingsRenderer savings_version="v1"> that maps known fields
  - Unknown fields go into a "Additional details" collapsed block (only if explicitly allowed by design)

Telemetry + analytics events (ENG-2409)
- Events (client):
  - suggestions_list_viewed
  - suggestion_opened (when drawer opens)
  - suggestions_filter_applied (includes which filters changed, not raw values if sensitive)
  - suggestions_load_more_clicked
- Payload rules:
  - include workspace_id, deployment_mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), suggestion_id for opened
  - do not include route name if it could contain customer-sensitive naming; prefer route_id hashed or internal ID (confirm with Logan)

Error handling specifics
- "Insufficient telemetry" case
  - Backend should provide reason_code and recommended next steps (string) if available
  - UI should display the reason_code-friendly copy. If none, fallback:
    - "We don’t have enough recent usage data to estimate savings yet." + link to docs
- "Stale estimates" case
  - If backend includes estimate_age_hours and it exceeds threshold, show warning banner:
    - "Estimates are based on older telemetry (last updated X days ago)."

Performance notes
- Keep list payload small: summary only
  - do not ship basis-of-estimate blobs in list response
- Prefetch detail on hover? Probably NO for beta (cost + privacy + perf). Maybe later.
- Table virtualization: not needed with cursor + limit=50, but revisit if customers ask.

QA notes / test cases (Leila)
- Gating
  - not allowlisted -> nav hidden; direct URL -> 403 handling
- RBAC
  - user without optimize:suggestions:read gets blocked
- Filters
  - applying filters resets list and cursor; URL updates
- Drawer deep link
  - suggestionId in URL opens drawer and fetches detail
- Schema resilience
  - missing fields render gracefully (no crash)
- Accessibility
  - keyboard open/close drawer; focus returns to last focused row

Open questions
- Should risk be filterable as multi-select? Design currently single select; might be useful to "hide high risk".
- Should we show Confidence as separate UI signal (chip/label) vs fold into risk?
  - see product debate thread; likely keep confidence numeric only in drawer for beta.
- Do we show savings as "$ per 1M tokens" OR "$/month" primarily?
  - current: table shows monthly estimate; drawer shows both.
- How do we handle tenants with multiple deployment modes (Hosted + Dedicated)?
  - filter by "Environment" maybe later; for beta, just scope to workspace.

Implementation checklist (near-term)
- [x] Basic list route + table + filters wired to BFF
- [x] Drawer skeleton + detail fetch
- [ ] Align empty states + copy with DES-189 final
- [ ] Risk chip a11y labels + color tokens (Design System)
- [ ] Ensure URL param parsing is robust + doesn’t refetch in a loop
- [ ] Add estimate-age warning banner (if backend provides)
- [ ] Add analytics events (PR-18690 is for impression/clickthrough; verify final naming)
- [ ] Coordinate with QA on stable selectors (data-testid) to avoid E2E flakes

Notes to self
- Avoid accidentally treating "0" savings as empty. There are legitimate cases with ~0 delta.
- Keep the drawer width consistent with Rollouts drawer to avoid jarring UX.
- Ensure we don’t log full payloads client-side in console; some basis fields could be sensitive.
